Metadata.description: Staffing simulator for consultancies: build a project team, see cost and margin live.

hero.title: Build the team. See the margin.
hero.lead: Squadio is a staffing simulator for consulting firms. Place people and open roles on a project team and watch cost, margin and effective rate change with every move.
hero.tryDemo: Try the demo, no account needed
hero.demoNote: Sample data, all fictional. Your changes are saved in a copy just for you.

notes.byCategory: Cost by category, never by person

problem.title: Margin is decided when you staff the project. You find out at month-end.
problem.lead: Every proposal starts with a spreadsheet: roles, rates, hours and a price. Then the team changes and the spreadsheet doesn't. By the time you see the gap, it's too late to fix it.

guesswork.title: Teams staffed on gut feeling
guesswork.text: People are picked without seeing what that mix really costs.

versions.title: Versions nobody trusts
versions.text: Three copies of the same sheet and no way to tell which one is right.

salaries.title: Salaries in plain sight
salaries.text: To run the numbers, someone ends up opening the sheet with the salaries.

how.title: Try teams before you commit them.

build.title: Build the team
build.text: Drag people or open roles from the bench, or use “Add to team”. Each assignment has its role, allocation, dates and who it reports to.

result.title: See the result instantly
result.text: Cost by category, overhead, buffer, revenue and net margin update with every change. Undo and redo, always at hand.

missing.title: Know what is missing
missing.text: If a category has no cost or rate, or the project has no price, Squadio works out everything it can and tells you which figures are pending and why. Never a made-up zero.

compare.title: Compare scenarios
compare.text: Duplicate a scenario, swap a senior for a junior or stretch a phase, and put two or three versions side by side.

visual.dropToFill: Drop to fill the open role
visual.pending: Total cost and margin are pending.

builtFor.title: Designed for how proposals are really put together.

salaries.title: Numbers without exposing salaries
salaries.text: Costs are set by category, not by person. People without rate access never receive a single euro: the database doesn't send it.

pricing.title: Fixed price and T&M
pricing.text: Fixed-price and time-and-materials projects, with the same logic in the same tool.

overhead.title: Overhead built in
overhead.text: The margin you see already accounts for overhead and buffer, using your organization's rates or each project's.

dates.title: Dates per assignment
dates.text: Each person joins and leaves the project when they actually do, with their allocation and effective hours.

partners.title: Partners and leadership
partners.text: Decide which team takes the project and at what price, with the margin in front of them, not at month-end.

operations.title: Operations
operations.text: See who is on which project and how busy they are today, without asking anyone for their spreadsheet.

managers.title: Project managers
managers.text: Build and adjust their team. Without rate access they see roles, hours and dates, never the money.

principles.title: What Squadio doesn't do.
principles.lead: It is built to prepare proposals, not to watch anyone.

salaries.title: Nobody's salary stored
salaries.text: Costs are by category, never by person.

judging.title: No judging people
judging.text: It analyses team structure and costs. It never suggests who to remove.

money.title: No money for the wrong eyes
money.text: Without rate access, the database doesn't send costs or margins.

availability.title: No promises about availability
availability.text: Busyness is today's, based on the projects recorded in Squadio.

roadmap.title: Where it stands.
roadmap.lead: Every version ships something you can try. Today: the demo with sample data.

simulate.title: Simulate
simulate.text: Drag people and open roles, live cost and margin, undo and redo.

prepare.title: Prepare
prepare.text: Your organization with its categories, people and projects.

compare.title: Compare
compare.text: Two or three scenarios side by side, and each person's load week by week.

share.title: Share
share.text: Revisions that never change and a link so someone else can choose.

revenue.definition: What the project bills. With a fixed price it is the agreed price; in time and materials, the effective hours times each category's sell rate.
revenue.formula: price, or Σ effective hours × sell rate

staffCost.definition: What the team costs: each category's effective hours times its cost per hour. Worked out per category, never per person.
staffCost.formula: Σ effective hours × cost per hour

directCost.definition: Staff cost plus the scenario's extra costs.

directMargin.definition: What revenue leaves after direct cost, before overhead and buffer.

overhead.definition: The company's costs that belong to no project: office, administration, sales. Spread as a percentage of staff cost.

buffer.definition: A cushion for the unexpected, as a percentage of direct cost plus overhead.

totalCost.definition: Everything the project costs: direct cost, overhead and buffer.

netMargin.definition: What revenue leaves after total cost. Its percentage is always over revenue.

effectiveRate.definition: What is billed per effective hour. The way to compare scenarios with the same fixed price.

effectiveHours.definition: Nominal hours less, on average, holidays, absences and training: the availability factor.

fullyLoaded.definition: What a person of the category costs a year: their gross salary, the employer's social security and other yearly costs.
fullyLoaded.formula: gross salary × (1 + social security) + other costs

costPerHour.definition: The fully loaded cost spread over the organization's net hours a year, or the one you type by hand.
costPerHour.formula: fully loaded cost ÷ net annual hours

upload.heading: Upload your file

how.heading: How it works
how.first: Categories and their costs first; people next.
how.match: You match your columns to Squadio's.
how.review: You review each row: errors are fixed here or in your file.
how.all: Everything or nothing is imported: a file with errors leaves no half-imported data.

review.heading: Review the rows

review.noIssues: No row has an error or a warning.
review.note: Click a marked cell to fix it here, or fix your file and upload it again. Empty cells never erase what you had.
